blocks.text: Four new members have been added to Documenta 16 ’s curatorial team headed by Naomi Beckwith , the German quinquennial has announced.

The additional members are Diné artist and composer Raven Chacon , who will join the team as its curator-at-large, while British Ghanaian curator, author and art historian Osei Bonsu , Roma/Sinti curator and art historian Timea Junghaus and and Israeli curator and scholar Noam Segal were picked as the quinquennial’s curatorial advisors.
The four will work alongside Beckwith’s all-women team announced last year, composed of Carla Acevedo-Yates, Romi Crawford, Mayra A. Rodríguez Castro and Xiaoyu Weng.
Documenta 16 is scheduled to open 12 June 2027 through 19 September 2027.
